shelfmark: Bodl. MS Arab. c 56.31 + Bodl. MS Arab. c 56.32
description:
Two folios from the "Canon of Medicine" by Avicenna. The folios are from ch. 14 of his work on the functions of the liver. YU. (https://shamela.ws/book/10706/1203). 

Folio 32 should be placed before folio 31, for the text on folio 31 follows immediately upon that on the verso of folio 32. The fragment is from Book III, the last few sentences of the penultimate faṣl (في العرق) and all the final faṣl (في احوال تعرض للمراق والشراسيف) and the fifth maqāla of the thirteenth fann, as well as the beginning of the first faṣl (في تشريح الكبد) of the first maqāla of the fourteenth fann. The text preserved is equivalent to that printed in the Būlāq ed., ii, 348-350. There is an interesting marginal annotation on folio 31a citing Bakhīshūʿ al-Nīshābūrī, in a chapter in pains of the liver and a statement made to him by طيطلوس (?). (information from Savage-Smith)
